title: Fix faulty `ilog2` spec
base_method: feature-lineage comparison: f0524f8a391671f07eaa6437a1a3159ef04b9173 is the common direct parent of parallel commits fee6f136c0a1b213967e615ff7c14c11cf7f1029 and e88149d52cd42e29fdad1598211d4e8f1ef7f3fb, which are the two parents of selected problem merge 7861acbd2ab1ec0577715f1f8407c2e5491e9e27. Both parents and the merge are tree-identical, so using target-side parent fee6f136 would produce an empty diff. The selected fixed ancestor yields the complete non-empty feature snapshot; the separate repair comparison is 7861acbd -> 9797a63e.
source_scope: Complete ostd/ at each commit, changed files outside ostd/, and original license/notice files. Changed submodules are expanded at their pinned commits.

verification.snapshot_selection: Selected official pre-repair merge 7861acbd2ab1ec0577715f1f8407c2e5491e9e27. Because that merge and both parents have identical trees, used their common feature-lineage parent f0524f8a391671f07eaa6437a1a3159ef04b9173 for the fixed non-empty evaluation comparison. The semantic repair is independently established by 9797a63e697a4f901a0a2e14c586729beed79a00; b94a3cdc9a0b23ddd92d67d5c99e974b08c0747c restates the same unsigned domain.
verification.zero_issues_meaning: Not applicable; the case contains one source-adjudicated semantic issue.
verification.source_export: Fixed Git ancestry, tree identities, changed path, and full-index diff were regenerated. The exporter must verify written blob bytes against the fixed objects before publication.
verification.toolchain: Compatibility verification used asterinas/verus 0b6f3cbb8fceff6681b4988c3cac37a8b801f8e6, Rust 1.88.0, and Z3 4.12.5. vstd_extra reported 236 verified/0 errors at both problem and repair. The problem pass is non-exculpatory because external_fn_specification trusts the wrapper and provides neither a nonzero precondition nor no_unwind. The verifier predates the July 14-15 commits by several days.
